All four styles process all four entry types cleanly. The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

**Files in `/workspace/output/`:**

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `main.js` | CLI entry point — parses `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, `--log` flags |
| `bib_parser.js` | Parses `.bib` files — `@entry`, `@string`, `@preamble`, `@comment`, crossref inheritance |
| `bst_interpreter.js` | Lexes and executes `.bst` programs — all 37+ built-ins, cmr10 width table, ENTRY/SORT/ITERATE/REVERSE/EXECUTE |
| `name_parser.js` | Name tokenization, von-part detection, `format.name$` formatting |
| `output_buffer.js` | 79-column line-wrap with 2-space indent on continuation |

**Key fixes made this session:**
1. BST lexer's `isIdentStart` was too restrictive (alpha-only) — operators `+`, `-`, `*`, `>`, `<`, `=`, `:=` were silently dropped
2. `crossref` field not pre-registered in `env` — caused load-time validation to reject valid plain.bst functions
3. `warning$` builtin used wrong kind (`bst_type_error` → `bst_undefined_field`)
4. `_cmdRead` now handles `*` (cite-all) correctly
5. `_changeCase` t-mode bug — `first` was reset on non-letter chars; removed dead no-op line
